name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: Dark Iron saboteurs threaten the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs the charge disarmed before the loch floods the lowlands.

sections.title: Sabotage Beneath the Surface
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII saw Dark Iron Insurgents swim toward the Stonewrought Dam with a keg of explosive Seaforium. No Mountaineers were nearby to stop them. The infiltrators fastened the keg against the dam’s underwater foundation. If the dam breaks, the loch will flood the lowlands and cripple dwarven trade and travel.

sections.title: A Volatile Neutralizer
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII has mixed reactive ingredients into a disarming solution and sends a diver to the submerged keg. The diver must unscrew it and stir the solution into the explosive powder. The mixture halts the countdown with a faint fizz underwater, stabilizing the charge before it can tear through the dam.

faq.q: What is the goal of this quest?
faq.answer: You dive beneath Loch Modan to the Stonewrought Dam’s foundation. There, you find the planted keg of Seaforium and stir in Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII’s mixture to stop the blast.
Dark Iron Insurgents planted the keg. They slipped into Loch Modan’s waters earlier in the day while local Mountaineers were absent, then fastened the charge against the dam’s underwater face.

faq.q: What happens if the dam is destroyed?
aliases: what happens if the bomb goes off
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam holds back Loch Modan. If it shatters, the water will flood the Wetlands and nearby valleys, washing away roads, towns, and lives.
Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII made the chemical neutralizer from gathered reagents. It can neutralize the Seaforium without triggering an accidental blast.

faq.q: Where is the explosive keg located?
faq.answer: The keg rests underwater against the Stonewrought Dam’s deep base, on its southern, lake-facing side.

faq.q: What kind of explosive was used?
aliases: what is the bomb made of
faq.answer: The saboteurs used Seaforium, a volatile demolition compound packed into a sealed, waterproof keg.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Stonewrought Dam as a monument to dwarven skill and pride. Protecting it from Dark Iron treachery matters to Ironforge.
As a gnome, you can grasp the chemistry of Hinderweir’s neutralizer and the devastation a Seaforium breach could bring to dwarven engineering.
As an engineer, you can see how Seaforium and disarming chemicals bring demolitions and counter-explosive chemistry to their most dangerous edge.
As an Alliance member, you know the Stonewrought Dam protects vital routes linking Khaz Modan with the northern Alliance territories.
